verdict.rationale: Qodo has a centralized rule system to 'define and enforce engineering standards' plus Rule Miner and config-as-code (.pr_agent.toml) that could encode custom checks, and it automatically reviews every PR with ranked findings. However, there is no explicit evidence of defining arbitrary plain-language pre-merge gates like 'docs updated' or 'tests cover new paths' that block/pass PRs as discrete custom checks — the rules system appears geared to coding standards/style rather than free-form pass/fail merge gates. Missing for 10: explicit examples of natural-language custom check definitions, evidence of pass/fail gating tied to PR merge status, and independent confirmation of this specific workflow.
